Description: Users must have unique IDs and role-based access controls. Privileged access must be approved and reviewed quarterly.
Evidence Required: Access control policy document, user provisioning logs, quarterly access review records

Description: MFA must be enforced for all remote access and privileged accounts.
Evidence Required: MFA configuration screenshots, privileged account list, remote access logs

Description: Sensitive data must be encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+).
Evidence Required: Encryption configuration documentation, TLS certificate records, key management policy

Description: System and security events must be logged and reviewed. Anomalies must trigger alerts.
Evidence Required: SIEM configuration, alert rules, log retention policy, incident escalation runbook

Description: A documented incident response plan must exist and be tested annually.
Evidence Required: Incident response plan, tabletop exercise records, post-incident reports

Description: All production changes must follow an approved change management process with peer review.
Evidence Required: Change management policy, approved change tickets, deployment logs

Description: Third-party vendors with access to sensitive data must be assessed annually.
Evidence Required: Vendor risk assessment records, security questionnaires, contracts with security clauses

Description: System uptime SLAs must be defined and monitored. Recovery time objectives must be documented.
Evidence Required: SLA documentation, uptime monitoring dashboard, DR test records

Description: Sensitive and confidential data must be classified and handled per the data classification policy.
Evidence Required: Data classification policy, data inventory, retention schedule

Description: Annual risk assessments must identify, evaluate, and document risks to information assets.
Evidence Required: Risk register, risk assessment reports, treatment plans
